# GingerBros

> GingerBros makes modern ginger drinks in Thailand. Tagline: "Think Ginger. Drink Different." Two drinks: Ginger Fizz (sparkling, fresh Thai ginger and real lime, low sugar, ฿140 per 330ml bottle) and Ginger Tea · Thai Spice (still, real ginger slowly simmered with lemongrass, lime and spices, no artificial colours or flavours, ฿119 per 330ml bottle). The drinks are not fermented. Sold online at gingerbrosshop.com with delivery across Thailand, plus LINE and Shopee.

## Shop
- [Shop all drinks](https://gingerbrosshop.com/shop): singles, 2/3/6-packs, Fizz & Tea mixed bundles, subscriptions. Multi-buy deals apply automatically in the cart.
- [Ginger Fizz](https://gingerbrosshop.com/product/ginger-fizz): ฿140; 2 for ฿260, 3 for ฿390, 6 for ฿780.
- [Ginger Tea · Thai Spice](https://gingerbrosshop.com/product/ginger-tea): ฿119; 2 for ฿220, 3 for ฿315, 6 for ฿600.
- [Fizz & Tea Duo](https://gingerbrosshop.com/product/fizz-tea-duo): ฿240. [Fizz & Tea 4-Pack](https://gingerbrosshop.com/product/fizz-tea-4pack): ฿460.
